title: Training-Time Batch Normalization Reshapes Local Partition Geometry in Piecewise-Affine Networks
abstract: arXiv:2605.04946v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The effect of batch normalization (BN) on the function realized during training is less understood than its effect on optimization. We study training-time BN in continuous piecewise-affine (CPA) networks through the affine regions they induce in local $\ell_\infty$ windows around the data. Conditioned on a mini-batch, every switching hyperplane of a BN layer with learned parameters and a general CPA activation is a translate of a hyperplane through the batch centroid, at an offset given by a standardized quantity times the batch spread, independent of the raw bias. We prove an exact formula, valid under general position, for the number of regions in a window in terms of window cuts and interior intersections. For a BN layer it gives a lower bound on the local count in terms of the standardized offsets; the bound depends on the batch only through its spread and not on the biases or the batch location. translated_title: 训练时批归一化重塑分段仿射网络中的局部划分几何
translated_abstract: 批归一化（BN）对训练期间所实现函数的影响，相较于其对优化的影响，人们的理解仍然较少。我们通过在数据周围局部 $\ell_\infty$ 窗口中所诱导的仿射区域，研究连续分段仿射（CPA）网络中的训练时BN。以小批次为条件，具有可学习参数和一般CPA激活函数的BN层的每个切换超平面，都是经过批次质心的某个超平面的平移，其偏移量由一个标准化量乘以批次散度给出，与原始偏置无关。我们证明了在一般位置条件下，用窗口切割数和内部交叉点数表示窗口中区域数量的精确公式。对于BN层，该公式给出了用标准化偏移量表示的局部区域计数下界；该下界仅通过批次散度依赖于批次，而与偏置或批次位置无关。在没有BN的情况下，所能得到的最好此类下界是……
tldr: 该论文证明了训练时BN层的切换超平面是批次质心超平面的平移，其偏移仅由标准化量与批次散度决定（与偏置和批次位置无关），并据此给出CPA网络局部线性区域数量的精确公式和下界，揭示BN从根本上重塑了网络的局部划分几何。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the switching hyperplanes of a training-time BN layer are translates of hyperplanes through the batch centroid, with offsets determined solely by standardized quantities times batch spread—independent of biases and batch location—and derives an exact formula and lower bound for local linear region counts, showing that BN reshapes the local partition geometry of CPA networks.
